items.english: Read the land before you change it. Find where water moves, where sunlight falls, where wind travels, and where cold air settles.
items.draft: Funda umhlaba phambi kokuba uwutshintshe. Fumana apho amanzi ahamba khona, apho ilanga liwela khona, apho umoya uhamba khona, nalapho umoya obandayo uhlala khona.
items.backtranslation: Read the land before you change it. Find where the water goes, where the sun sets/crosses, where the wind goes, and where the cold air stays.
items.corrected: Funda umhlaba phambi kokuba uwutshintshe. Fumana apho amanzi ahamba khona, apho ilanga likhanya khona, apho umoya uhamba khona, nalapho umoya obandayo uhlala khona.

items.english: Poorly laid contours can increase erosion, and soil that takes in water slowly can hold too much. Choose any water works for the site and plan a safe route for excess water.
items.draft: Imigca yokuphakama ebekwe kakubi inokunyusa ukukhukuliseka komhlaba, kwaye umhlaba ofunxa amanzi kancinci unokubamba amanzi amaninzi kakhulu. Khetha nayiphi na imisebenzi yamanzi efanelekileyo kwindawo yakho kwaye ucwangcise indlela ekhuselekileyo yamanzi agqithisileyo.
items.backtranslation: Contours placed badly can increase soil erosion, and soil that absorbs water slowly can hold too much water. Choose whatever water works suit your place and plan a safe route for excess water.
items.problem: "ofunxa amanzi kancinci" reads as soil absorbing a little water (not slowly) and sounds contradictory with holding too much
items.corrected: Imigca yokuphakama ebekwe kakubi inokunyusa ukukhukuliseka komhlaba, kwaye umhlaba ofunxa amanzi ngokucotha unokubamba amanzi amaninzi kakhulu. Khetha nayiphi na imisebenzi yamanzi efanelekileyo kwindawo yakho kwaye ucwangcise indlela ekhuselekileyo yamanzi agqithisileyo.

items.english: Then draw the patterns you have observed. Your map becomes the design skeleton for the whole smallholding.
items.draft: Emva koko zoba iindlela ozibonileyo. Imephu yakho iba sisakhelo soyilo lwayo yonke ifama encinci.
items.backtranslation: After that, draw the paths you have seen. Your map becomes the framework of the design of the whole small farm.
items.problem: "patterns" rendered as "iindlela" (ways/roads), which reads as roads/paths already listed in the same lesson
items.corrected: Emva koko zoba iipatheni ozibonileyo. Imephu yakho iba sisakhelo soyilo lwayo yonke ifama encinci.

items.english: Return at dawn on a cold June morning. Mark mist, frozen dew, and the places frost lasts longest.
items.draft: Buya ekuseni kakhulu ngentsasa ebandayo yoJuni. Phawula inkungu, amathontsi enkungu akhenkcezileyo, neendawo apho iqabaka lihlala ixesha elide.
items.backtranslation: Come back very early in the morning on a cold June morning. Mark fog, frozen drops of fog, and places where frost stays a long time.
items.problem: "frozen dew" rendered as frozen fog droplets
items.corrected: Buya ekuseni kakhulu ngentsasa ebandayo yoJuni. Phawula inkungu, amazolo akhenkcezileyo, neendawo apho iqabaka lihlala ixesha elide.

items.english: Add summer and winter wind arrows, shade observations from 8am, midday, and 4pm, and your zones and sectors. Keep the map and update it.
items.draft: Yongeza imicibisholo yomoya wasehlotyeni nowasebusika, ukuqwalasela umthunzi nge-8am, emini nge-4pm, neendawo (zones) neesektha (sectors) zakho. Gcina imephu uze uyihlaziye.
items.backtranslation: Add arrows for summer and winter wind, shade observations at 8am, noon and 4pm, and your zones and sectors. Keep the map and update it.
items.problem: missing comma makes "midday at 4pm" read as one time
items.corrected: Yongeza imicibisholo yomoya wasehlotyeni nowasebusika, ukuqwalasela umthunzi nge-8am, emini, nge-4pm, neendawo (zones) neesektha (sectors) zakho. Gcina imephu uze uyihlaziye.
